name: dsh-growth
description: Evidence-backed growth analysis tools for AARRR funnels, retention, experiments and MRR.

interface.shortDescription: A local-first growth operating system for Markdown data.
interface.longDescription: Growth Acquisition turns local Markdown, CSV and JSONL data into explainable AARRR funnels, cohort retention, MRR bridges, unit economics, growth experiments and WBR/MBR reports.
defaultPrompt: Run a read-only growth onboarding check; show ready, partial, missing and unsupported items, then give the top two gaps.
Run a growth review using local data; show selected sources, evidence gaps and the next action.
Turn the biggest growth bottleneck into a HADI experiment and prioritize it with RICE.
